question: g3_checkout_request
answer:
Done. Created [checkoutRequest.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g3_checkout_request/source/codex/2/src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs) — a dependency-free ES module exporting `buildCheckoutRequest`, which returns `{method: "POST", path: "cart/<cartCode>/checkout", body}`. I verified it by importing and running it with a sample cart.

The backend (SalesManager) deserializes that endpoint's body into `PersistableAnonymousOrder` (v1), whose request field names differ from what Checkout.js currently sends:

| Concept | Backend field |
|---|---|
| chosen shipping option | `quoteId` (not `shippingQuote`) |
| currency | `currency` |
| terms accepted | `termsAccepted` |
| order comment | `orderNote` |
| payment object | `payment` |
| payment module | `processor` (not `paymentModule`) |
| payment token | `cardToken` (not `paymentToken`) |
| amount | `amount` |
| payment/transaction type | `paymentType: "CREDITCARD"`, `transactionType: "CAPTURE"` |

Files I used (no other files changed):

- [Checkout.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g3_checkout_request/source/codex/2/src/pages/other/Checkout.js) — the existing storefront request shape
- [OrderApi.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/order/OrderApi.java) — the `cart/{code}/checkout` endpoints and their request body types
- [Order.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/order/v1/Order.java) and [PersistableOrder.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/order/v1/PersistableOrder.java) — `termsAccepted`, `orderNote`, `currency`, `quoteId`, `payment`
- [PersistablePayment.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/order/transaction/PersistablePayment.java) and [PaymentEntity.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/order/transaction/PaymentEntity.java) — `cardToken`, `processor`, `amount`, `paymentType`, `transactionType`
- [PaymentType.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-core-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/model/payments/PaymentType.java) / [TransactionType.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-core-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/model/payments/TransactionType.java) — confirmed `CREDITCARD` and `CAPTURE` enum values
